description: Every nonzero class modulo finite subsets of the naturals is the join of two nonzero classes whose meet is zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.split_nonzero_class
  (q : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.FiniteQuotient) (hq : q ≠ ⊥) :
  ∃ u v, u ≠ ⊥ ∧ v ≠ ⊥ ∧ u ⊓ v = ⊥ ∧ u ⊔ v = q
